newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP board okays Canadian diamond plan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP board okays Canadian diamond plan.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday its board had approved the company's investment in the proposed Northwest Territories Diamond Project in Canada.
"The A$700 million project now requires final approval by the Canadian government and resolution of final agreements which satisfy the company," BHP said in a statement.
BHP is developing the project with Dia Met Minerals Ltd.

BHP noted the Canadian government had accepted the recommendations of an environmental assessment review panel for approval of the project, subject to reviewing progress on negotiations for an environmental agreement with federal authorities as well as socio-economic agreeements with the government of the Northwest Territories and aboriginal groups.
"BHP and its partners are continuing to work with the federal and Northwest Territories governments in Canada and other parties to meet all regulatory requirements," BHP said.
The company said it hoped to be in a position to start production in the second half of 1998.
